{{Current events|year=2022|month=01|day=10|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]]
**[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] authorities arrest an alleged [[Russia]]n intelligence agent who they claim attempted to recruit others to launch attacks in the port city of [[Odessa]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/ukraine-says-arrests-russian-agent-planning-attacks-in-odessa/ar-AASCZjU?ocid=entnewsntp (MSN)]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**The pro-[[Government of Yemen|Yemeni government]] militia [[Giants Brigades]] say that they are in "full control" of the [[Shabwah Governorate]] after ten days of fighting [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] forces. [https://amp.france24.com/en/live-news/20220110-yemen-pro-government-troops-capture-oil-rich-shabwa (France 24)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The [[United States Mint]] announces that they have started shipping the first coins of the [[American Women quarters]] program. American poet [[Maya Angelou]] will become the first [[African Americans|African American]] woman to be featured on a [[Quarter (United States coin)|U.S. quarter]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/589060-treasury-rolls-out-quarters-featuring-maya-angelou-first-black-woman (''The Hill'')] [https://www.npr.org/2022/01/10/1071965134/maya-angelou-quarter-mint-shipped-first-black-woman (NPR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed and hundreds more are left [[Homelessness in South Africa|homeless]] due to [[flood]]s in [[East London, Eastern Cape|East London]], [[South Africa]], as poorly built homes are swept away, especially in [[Mdantsane]] just outside the city. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/floods-kill-10-leave-hundreds-homeless-south-african-city-2022-01-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[India]] begins administering COVID-19 vaccine [[booster dose]]s for high-risk individuals, such as [[healthcare worker]]s and people over the age of 60 with comorbidities. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/india-begins-administering-booster-doze-of-covid-vaccine-in-high-risk-population/articleshow/88802223.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Indonesia]]
****The [[Indonesia]]n [[National Agency of Drug and Food Control of Indonesia|Drug and Food Control Agency]] issues an [[emergency use authorization]] of five [[COVID-19 vaccine]]s as [[booster dose]], namely [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech]], [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca]], [[CoronaVac]], and Zifivax's [[ZF2001]] for one dose, and half dose of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://amp.kompas.com/nasional/read/2022/01/10/13281111/bpom-tetapkan-vaksin-moderna-setengah-dosis-sebagai-booster (''Kompas'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] bans mass public gatherings of more than 25 people, closes schools until January 29 and mandates [[COVID-19 vaccination in Nepal|proof of vaccination]] in order to enter hotels, parks, restaurants, cinema halls, and public office beginning on January 21 due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nepal-closes-schools-covid-19-cases-spike-2022-01-10/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 28,707 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,998,530. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/01/10/22/ph-posts-33169-new-covid-cases-46pct-positivity-rate (ABS-CBN News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
*****The [[Government of Ontario|Ontario government]] says that [[Ontario|the province]] will resume in-person learning for students by January 17. [https://ottawacitizen.com/news/local-news/covid-19-ontario-hospitalizations-continue-to-rise-12-new-deaths-reported/wcm/d0cb4411-a7e5-420c-b06a-2cbb0bb1856a/amp/ (''Ottawa Citizen'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico|Mexican]] [[President of Mexico|president]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] tests positive for COVID-19 for the second time. [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2022/01/10/1071975804/mexico-president-andres-lopez-obrador-covid-positive (NPR)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 18 deaths from [[COVID-19]], thereby bringing the statewide death toll to 745.  [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/jan/10/toddler-with-rare-genetic-condition-among-record-18-covid-deaths-in-nsw (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Australia]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/10/australia-to-push-through-omicron-as-total-cases-hit-1-million (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
***[[Chile]] begins administering second [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to people who are most vulnerable to COVID-19, including [[immunocompromised]] people, becoming the first country in [[Latin America]] to do so. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-health-chile-santiago-d5a409d2355ed610b85eea3a93f2bdf3 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***[[Italy]] restricts the access of [[public transport]], [[coffee shop]]s, gyms, and many other activities to people who have been [[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy|vaccinated]] or has been recovered from COVID-19 amid the surge of the COVID-19 cases driven by the Omicron variant. [https://news.sky.com/story/unvaccinated-people-banned-from-public-transport-coffee-shops-and-gyms-in-italy-12513161 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uganda]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
***[[Uganda]] reopens schools for the first time since March 2020 after a nearly two year closure due to the COVID-19 pandemic. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/uganda-covid19-schools-closure-world-b1989915.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[History of COVID-19 vaccine development|COVID-19 vaccine development]]
***[[Pfizer]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Albert Bourla]] says that the company will develop a [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to target the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]] by March. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/01/10/covid-vaccine-pfizer-ceo-says-omicron-vaccine-will-be-ready-in-march.html (CNBC)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[Russia]] and the [[United States|U.S.]] begin a series of talks in [[Geneva]] in a effort to [[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis|defuse tensions]] between both countries as well as tensions with [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jan/09/ukraine-fate-hangs-in-balance-as-critical-week-of-talks-begins (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021–2022 social unrest in the French West Indies]]
**Roadblocks were set up by demonstrators and stones were thrown at the police in [[Basse-Terre]]. [https://la1ere.francetvinfo.fr/guadeloupe/matinee-enflammee-dans-le-quartier-de-riviere-des-peres-a-basse-terre-1200379.html/ (France info)]
*The ''[[Peoples Gazette]]'', a [[Nigeria|Nigerian]] online newspaper, claims that it has been raided by the [[National Intelligence Agency (Nigeria)|National Intelligence Agency]]. [https://gazettengr.com/just-in-nia-storms-peoples-gazettes-head-office-demands-source-of-confidential-memo-exposing-dg-rufai-abubakar/ (''Peoples Gazette'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Xenotransplantation]]
**[[Doctors]] at the [[University of Maryland, Baltimore]], successfully [[heart transplant|transplant]] a [[pig]] [[heart]] into a human patient for the first time. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/1st-us-surgeons-transplant-pig-heart-human-patient-82185933 (ABC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2022 Australian Open]]
***The [[Federal Court of Australia]] orders that [[Serbia]]n tennis player [[Novak Djokovic]] be released from [[Immigration detention in Australia|immigration detention]] and allowed to compete in the Australian Open in order to defend his Championship, and also orders the federal government to pay Djokovic's legal fees. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-59932430 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 College Football Playoff National Championship]]
**In [[American football]], [[2021 Georgia Bulldogs football team|Georgia]] defeats [[2021 Alabama Crimson Tide football team|Alabama]] to win the national championship, its first since [[1980 Georgia Bulldogs football team|1980]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/georgia-bulldogs-ncaa-football-national-title/ (CBS News)]
